relations.subject: Meenakshisundaram Pillai
relations.evidence: It was this particular mutt at tiruvAvaTutuRai which had the great Tamil scholar Meenakshisundaram Pillai, an upper caste non-Brahmin, as its AstAna vidvAn.

relations.subject: U. V. Swaminatha Iyer
relations.evidence: U. V. Swaminatha Iyer, a SmArtta Brahmin, who played a major role in the rediscovery of Tamil Classical Literature was supported by this mutt and was a student of Pillai.

relations.subject: Kamil Zvelebil
relations.evidence: In fact, even Zvelebil traces his Tamil scholarship lineage to Pillai.(See his "Companion Studies to the history of Tamil Literature")
